paragraphs.text: Agent-led audio production toolkit: sampled instruments, timeline-based arranging, sound effects, TT
S, multitrack mixing, and video muxing.
Hear the difference · Install · Sound sources · Speech TTS · 中文说明
AnyAudio is an audio production toolkit for AI agents. It turns a sound idea into an actual audio pr
oject: write notes and render real instruments, write lines and generate speech, drop in sound effec
ts, arrange the structure, and mix the multitrack result. Video soundtracks are just one use — scene
s, sound design, standalone music, audiobooks, podcasts and game audio all come out of the same pipe
und design, standalone music, audiobooks, podcasts and game audio all come out of the same pipeline.
The agent keeps the creative decisions. AnyAudio supplies the tools and execution needed to turn a s
ound idea into a finished audio file.
## What it solves
Models can already write code that makes sound, but it rarely sounds like an instrument, a recording
, or a finished mix. AnyAudio fills that gap:
- **Real instrument timbres** — rendered from local sample banks instead of hand-written oscillators

.
- **Notes land directly on the timeline** — millisecond accuracy; music, narration and effects sha

re one clock.
- **Automatic mix balance** — tracks are placed in order with per-track gain, pan and
fades; declaring a track as `narration` makes the plugin duck the other buses under the voice, and t

he master is peak-normalised so the whole mix does not clip.
- **Effects and voices** — sound effect
s either sampled from the installed banks or generated procedurally, plus speech through Edge TTS an
d MiMo-V2.5-TTS (currently free).
## Hear the difference
Both pairs contain identical material: one version made without the plugin, one with it. Listen firs
t, read the numbers after.

ng NumPy synthesis directly; version B was rendered by AnyAudio from local sample banks. Same arrang
ement, only the sound source changed.

## Install
Node.js 22.19+ (22.x) or 24+ (bundled with DSH); ffmpeg is only needed for speech and for muxing vid
e.js 22.19+ (22.x) or 24+ (bundled with DSH); ffmpeg is only needed for speech and for muxing video.

If DSH boots a different profile, replace `desktop` with that profile name. Restart DSH once after i
nstalling so it picks up the plugin.
Then open the **AnyAudio** page in DSH Settings to install a sound source (GeneralUser GS is the def
ault suggestion), switch the speech engine and adjust mixing defaults. No SoundFont is bundled with
ion), switch the speech engine and adjust mixing defaults. No SoundFont is bundled with the package.
### From source
For local development, install from a clone instead of the registry:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The path must be absolute (on Windows, `D:/any-audio` style), and DSH needs a restart once after add
ing it. `npm run font` downloads both suggested banks (about 72 MB) into the shared sound library, w
hich is handy when you want the banks ready before opening Settings.
A clone also gives you the headless renderer, useful for iterating on a score without an agent:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Quick start
Describe the work as usual while generating a video; the agent calls the plugin to render audio on i
e the work as usual while generating a video; the agent calls the plugin to render audio on its own:
> Make a 30-second ink-wash animation: a seed in a rock crevice grows into a sapling. Add a little C
hinese-style music and wind, no narration.
You can adjust musical detail and mixing behaviour as you go:
> Guzheng lead, strings bed, cello on the low end; pull the music down whenever a voice comes in.
For a song, state the brief and call it directly:
> Write me a Japanese RPG battle theme, loopable, 30 to 60 seconds. Drums, electric guitar and strin
rite me a Japanese RPG battle theme, loopable, 30 to 60 seconds. Drums, electric guitar and strings.
[该节后续省略]
## Known limitations
- **SoundFont only** — no SFZ, Kontakt or VST; converting other source formats is out of scope for t

his version.
- **No per-note envelope control** — attack and release come from the preset; use short

notes with gaps for staccato and velocity plus expression for dynamics.
- **Chinese instruments are
GM approximations** — `guzheng` maps to Koto, `dizi` to Flute, `erhu` to Fiddle; dedicated banks wi
tions** — `guzheng` maps to Koto, `dizi` to Flute, `erhu` to Fiddle; dedicated banks will do better.
